adaptation: Unmodified PNGs. The hub repeats the first native empty inventory cell into ten generic equipped slots (two rows of five) and a 40-cell selection area. Character Gear and Skill Items have independent ten-slot loadouts and category-filtered selection; their item catalogs are currently empty. The original eight-position board and crystal icon remain references. Full-body portraits use shared character-gallery framing. Cosmetics uses existing Qi orb artwork with a shared UI tint shader for regular blue and four local colors, independently of gear slots. All three pages save per fighter or stable pet identity. Old crystal/numbered-slot colors migrate into cosmetics without replacing existing choices.
